name: io.github.NKSTUD/lws-mcp
title: LWS
description: Manage LWS (lws.fr) domains, DNS zones, hosting and account from any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: LWS_LOGIN
environmentVariables.description: Your LWS account ID (the digits of LWS-XXXXXX)

environmentVariables.name: LWS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: LWS API key (LWS Panel > Api LWS)

environmentVariables.name: LWS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true to expose only read tools

environmentVariables.name: LWS_ENABLE_PURCHASES
environmentVariables.description: true to expose the paid tools (buy, renew)

environmentVariables.name: LWS_TEST_MODE
environmentVariables.description: true to use the LWS test environment

environmentVariables.name: LWS_TEST_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Test key, used instead of LWS_API_KEY in test mode
